triggers.title: SR 26-2: Revised Guidance on Model Risk Management
triggers.issuer: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, with the OCC and FDIC

facts.text: Issues revised interagency guidance on model risk management that supersedes SR 11-7 (2011) and SR 21-8 (2021).
The letter says it is expected to be most relevant to banking organizations with over $30 billion in total assets regulated by the Federal Reserve.

CA.text: OSFI Guideline E-23 (Model Risk Management) covers model risk, including AI and machine learning models, and takes effect on May 1, 2027.
OSFI Guideline B-13 (Technology and Cyber Risk Management) sets expectations for federally regulated financial institutions.
